svg.aria-label: GitHub activity since the first day on GitHub (Feb 2024): 473 contributions, 201 commits, 37 repositories, 116 active days, longest streak 11 days. Best day Dec 15, 2024 with 47. A contribution galaxy: one orbit per year with a star for every active day, constellations of the busiest days and a supernova on the best day.
svg.text: one square each, brighter means busier
